svg.title: SELAP UI Screen Designs
svg.desc: English SVG mockups for authentication, public catalog, property detail, favorites, admin approval, agent lead claiming, property form, and staff directory screens.
svg.text: Primary color #328ba8. All labels and interface copy are in English. Each artboard shows the requested flow and important event states.
